file_roles.evidence: The report names this file by link and states the wrong logic in it: 'On mongos, however, we only look at the command name passed into the [request|https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/f8be36eca7f5d17b0cbea557e8825046352eea19/src/mongo/s/commands/strategy.cpp#L1029]. This means that we will incorrectly mark inExhaustIsMaster as false if we send "ismaster" instead of "isMaster" to mongos.' It also prescribes the adopted fix: 'Mongos should look up the request's command name in the command registry so that any aliases to the isMaster command are correctly covered.'

rationale: The wrong decision is made in mongos, where the raw request command name is used instead of the registry lookup mongod performs, so 'we will incorrectly mark inExhaustIsMaster as false'. The wrong value is then held and observed in the exhaust isMaster metrics, which the report links at src/mongo/transport/ismaster_metrics.cpp#L87-L94 as where the tracking happens, so the bad state is created at one site and read at another. The single gold file is the site that creates it.
